about.title: Laguna Niguel Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: A defective product doesn't need a busy intersection or a rush-hour crash to cause harm — it can happen at home, at work, or anywhere in Laguna Niguel. Whether it's a household appliance that malfunctions, a piece of equipment with a hidden manufacturing flaw, or a product lacking adequate warnings, California law generally allows injured residents to pursue a claim without proving the manufacturer was careless. That's the core of strict liability: if the product was defective and it caused injury, that may be enough. Manufacturers, distributors, and even retailers along the supply chain can potentially share responsibility. Our team evaluates these cases and explains what evidence — including the product itself — matters most. If you were hurt by something that should have worked safely and didn't, it may be worth a conversation with us.

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify Your Path
items.desc: Because California often applies strict liability to defective products, you generally don't need to prove the manufacturer was negligent — just that the defect existed and caused harm.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable, which may open more than one avenue for recovery.

items.title: Evidence Preservation Guidance
items.desc: Our team can advise you early on keeping the product itself intact, since it's often the most important piece of evidence in these claims.

items.question: Do I need to prove the manufacturer was careless?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California's strict liability standard generally focuses on whether the product itself was defective — in design, manufacturing, or warnings — and whether that defect caused your injury. This can make the process different from a typical negligence claim.

items.question: What should I do with the product that injured me?
items.answer: Keep it exactly as it was at the time of the injury, if possible, including any packaging or instructions. The product is often key evidence, and we can advise on how to preserve it properly.

items.question: Is this only for injuries from cars or crashes in Laguna Niguel?
items.answer: No. While Laguna Niguel sees reported crashes concentrated on corridors like Crown Valley Parkway and Golden Lantern, product liability claims cover defective items used at home, work, or anywhere else in the city — not just vehicles or roadways.

items.question: Do you charge anything upfront?
items.answer: No. Our team typically works on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation.
